summary: Ground explicit Email subject claims to one complete Subject header in their own citations.
decision_refs: The active objective requires accurate file-grounded questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
An offline reproduction proved that an invented Email subject passed when the citation was exact but contained a different Subject header
A bounded exact header-value check closes the structured metadata gap without semantic paraphrase scoring, a dependency or another model request
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only explicit Subject headers and explicit Subject, Email subject or Subject line claims enter this guard; it does not score semantic paraphrases.
Only evidence conservatively classified as Email can ground an Email subject; an RFI or Submittal form's Subject field remains its own source type.
Case, repeated whitespace, outer quotation marks and answer-ending punctuation outside the subject value normalize, while punctuation quoted inside the subject stays exact.
The guard does not infer which message in quoted history is current, whether reply prefixes are equivalent, or which sender or source has authority.
Header unfolding remains the responsibility of the existing Email parser; this change does not connect to a mailbox or alter source parsing.
